resources.string: Translates German on-screen text into English. Triggered from the Quick Settings tile; uses on-device ML Kit translation and displays results as an accessibility overlay. Required so the Quick Settings tile can read the current screen and render translation cards.

Because this is a sideloaded APK, Android 13+ blocks enabling the service from the regular Accessibility screen. To allow it: 1) Long-press the app icon → App Info → three-dot menu → \"Allow restricted settings\". 2) Then go back to Settings → Accessibility → Screen Translator → enable.
German on-screen text is translated into this language. The change takes effect immediately for both the test below and the Quick Settings tile (no need to re-enable accessibility).
The language to translate FROM. Use Auto-Detect to let ML Kit identify the source language automatically.
Pull down the shade twice → edit → drag the \"Translate Screen\" tile into the active row. Then open any German app and tap the tile to translate the screen.
Der Schnellzugriff übersetzt deutschen Bildschirmtext ins Englische.
Download the model first — open the app and tap Download model.
Live translation active — tap ✕ or the tile to stop
No app window found — open an app first, then tap the tile.
Target window has no readable content.
Nothing to translate — is the model downloaded? Is the text in the source language?

Tap the Quick Settings tile once to start live translation. Tap the ✕ (or the tile again, or the Stop notification action) to stop. Drag the ✕ to move it out of the way. The overlay auto-hides after 90s of inactivity.
No translations yet — open an app and tap the tile.
